mentions.name: FastPause
mentions.description: This app is an intermittent fasting and mindful eating companion built as an offline-first PWA with no tracking. It shows a visual streak of previous fasts in a calendar widget on the dashboard to keep the user motivated and consistent, and includes a BMI calculator that saves entered values for reuse. It helped the author push through a weight-loss plateau.
mentions.problem: Staying consistent with intermittent fasting, and the annoyance of re-entering all values from scratch on the NHS BMI calculator each visit.
mentions.audience: Personal use - the author is currently the only user

mentions.name: FastPause
mentions.description: Offline-first progressive web app for intermittent fasting tracking and mindful eating. Requires no account and contains no ads, tracking, cookies, or AI integrations, staying lightweight (~2 MB bundle) compared with 200 MB fasting apps on app stores. Supports weight-loss habit building around IF and mindful eating.
mentions.problem: Existing intermittent fasting apps are bloated with ads, tracking, and huge app sizes, making a lightweight, privacy-respecting fasting tracker hard to find.
mentions.audience: Built for personal use by the author; built out of annoyance with bloated existing fasting apps
